_about: Frozen Family Chat wire contract of the two earlier revisions the browser suites replay. Nothing here is written by hand except the schema copy: each document is the exact text that apps/bnest-app/assets/js/family_chat/operations.js returns at commit 4ee4027 (origin/main just before #239 removed the family-chat release flags), imported with Node and called with replies false (previousClient). The schema is copied from apps/bnest-app/lib/bnest_app_web/schema.ex and schema/types/family_chat_types.ex and web_push_types.ex at 4ee4027, which #239 left unchanged. Change this file only by re-capturing from a named commit in the same change that needs it.

previousClient._about: The pre-reply bundle: what a browser loaded before the reply feature still sends and reads. The current server must keep accepting these documents.

rolledBackSlot._about: The schema of the revision a rollback may route back to. The documents the current bundle sends must pass it.
